thread:
Miguel R: hey team — hitting a regression after today's rollout. Our downstream validator (3rd-party JSON schema) started failing for a subset of responses. We only started seeing this at ~09:12 UTC after the model switch. It manifests as required fields coming back null in array items. example below.

Miguel R: reproduction (quick):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model": "rwd-text-2.4", "input": "Extract product entries from this text...", "structured_output": {"mode": "json_schema", "schema": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["id","name","price"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"number"}}}}}}'
```

Miguel R: expected (old model):
```
[ {"id":"p_123","name":"Widget","price":9.99}, {"id":"p_124","name":"Gizmo","price":14.5} ]
```

Miguel R: actual (after rollout):
```
[ {"id":null,"name":"Widget","price":9.99}, {"id":"p_124","name":null,"price":14.5} ]
```

Miguel R: validator error (from our ingestion service):
```
ValidationError: items[0].id: must be string, got null
 at validate (schema-validator.js:45)
 at parseResponse (...)
```

Sara K: ack — sorry you're hitting this, thanks for the clear repro. Can you confirm which API host (hosted vs dedicated/private) and whether you were pinned to a model or on auto-rollout? Also can you paste the full request headers (no auth token) and the model name you saw in the response metadata?

Miguel R: hosted API (app region: us-west-2). We were on the default model alias (not pinned). The response metadata in the body shows model: rwd-text-2.4-2026-03-15. Header X-Request-ID: req_01F8XYZ. I attached the response body above.

Sara K: escalated to eng-oncall, passing along X-Request-ID and sample output. Priya, can you take a look?

deploy-bot: rollout complete — rwd-text-2.4 promoted to alias "stable" at 1769456000 by ops-deploy (canary 10% -> 100%).

Priya S: looking. quick question: is your downstream validator strict about nulls in required fields (i.e., treats null like missing)? That could explain failure, but either way the model shouldn't emit null for required string fields.

Miguel R: yes, the JSON schema we're validating against declares id/name as required with type string. We've never seen nulls in these fields before. This started only after the rollout.

Priya S: thanks. i'm running a couple of automated checks against the same prompt on previous model snapshot (rwd-text-2.3) and the new one (rwd-text-2.4). quick findings: 1) rwd-text-2.3 returns string IDs consistently; 2) rwd-text-2.4 occasionally emits `null` for fields it can't confidently extract when using the json_schema structured mode. It looks like an internal change in the structured-output fallback behavior: instead of emitting an empty string or omitting the property, it's now emitting JSON null for low-confidence tokens.

Priya S: can you share whether you rely on presence of the key vs non-null value? i.e., do you accept "id":"" or must it be absent?

Miguel R: our validator requires type string, empty string is allowed, null is not. Key presence is required.

Priya S: ok that's consistent. short-term mitigation: set a post-processing step to convert null -> "" for those fields, or run a light schema-validation step to coerce nulls. i'll flag this as a regression and propose a rollback for the stable alias while we triage.

Alex T: adding product context: we pushed changes to how the structured_output transformer handles low-confidence tokens in model-generated JSON to make the outputs more explicit for downstream consumers. apparently the change produced nulls in place of strings. We should consider the backward-compatibility impact.

Priya S: root cause hypothesis: the new transformer introduced a 3-state token representation (value | empty-string | NULL) and defaulted to null when the lattice couldn't produce a token within the top-k threshold. rwd-text-2.4 integrates that transformer. We'll confirm with eval traces.

Priya S: immediate action items (from oncall):
- replicate customer prompt across a batch of inputs to measure null-rate (in progress)
- create rollback of alias "stable" to previous snapshot rwd-text-2.3 if null-rate > 1% for required fields
- open internal bug with trace logs and examples
- provide customer mitigation guidance (post-process or pin model)

Miguel R: can you confirm whether pinning to rwd-text-2.3 is doable from our end? We need a quick workaround for production.

Sara K: yes — you can explicitly set "model": "rwd-text-2.3" in your requests to pin. I'll send a config snippet. If you need billing-related guidance, that shouldn't change usage billing, it's just model version selector.

Sara K: snippet for pinning:
```
{"model":"rwd-text-2.3", "input":"...", "structured_output":{...}}
```

Miguel R: thanks — we'll pin for now and add a post-process to coerce nulls. Please keep us posted on rollback.

Priya S: update: ran 500 samples with customer's prompt templates. rwd-text-2.3 null-rate = 0.2% (essentially noise). rwd-text-2.4 null-rate = 6.8% for required string fields. That's above our safe threshold. I'm going to prepare rollback for alias "stable" to rwd-text-2.3 and propose a canary re-roll with adjusted transformer config.

Priya S: creating bug: BUG-9981 — structured-output: string fields emitted as null after transformer change. Includes 20 sample payloads and request IDs (attaching).

Alex T: agree with rollback. Priya, coordinate with infra to do a coordinated rollback and communicate change window. Sara, please tell Miguel expected timeline.

Sara K: Miguel — we plan to rollback the stable alias in the next 30 mins, then run a short smoke test and confirm. I'll DM you the schedule and once done will post here.

deploy-bot: rollback scheduled — alias stable -> rwd-text-2.3 at 1769457100 (initiated by priya).

Priya S: rollback started. running smoke tests...

Priya S: smoke tests pass on a 50-sample run. null-rate back to baseline. rolling update complete.

Sara K: rollback complete. Please test and confirm.

Miguel R: confirmed — validator errors gone, ingestion back to normal. Thanks everyone. We'll leave pin to rwd-text-2.3 until you advise.

Priya S: long-term follow-ups:
- revamp transformer config to avoid nulls for required string fields (prefer empty string or omit)
- add a regression test in the structured-output eval harness for strict-schema consumers
- provide release notes flagging structured_output behavior change

Alex T: also add a migration note and a flag in Console release that highlights breaking change potential.

Miguel R: appreciated. If you can include a suggested policy for how to handle nulls in the short release notes that would help our SREs.

Sara K: will compile a short note and post here + email point-of-contact. closing for now but we'll reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
